d:
Jagannath Mishra, once very close to sanjay gandhi, was Chief Minister of Bihar thrice in 70s and 80s. He was appointed Chief Minister after assassination of his elder brother and then railway minister Lalit narayan Mishra. His tanure as a CM was known for various scams and scandals like Bobby mysterious death, co-operative scam, fodder scam etc. Later in 2013, he was convicted in fodder scam and his political career has been ended.
